definitions.explanation: The city that serves as the seat of government for a country.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{首都|しゅと}は{東京|とうきょう}だ。
examples.english: The capital of Japan is Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {首都|しゅと}に{人口|じんこう}が{集中|しゅうちゅう}している。
examples.english: The population is concentrated in the capital.

examples.japanese: フランスの{首都|しゅと}パリは、{芸術|げいじゅつ}と{文化|ぶんか}の{中心地|ちゅうしんち}として{世界的|せかいてき}に{有名|ゆうめい}だ。{毎年|まいとし}{多|おお}くの{観光客|かんこうきゃく}が{訪|おとず}れる。
examples.english: Paris, the capital of France, is world-famous as a center of art and culture. Many tourists visit every year.

notes:
{首都|しゅと} refers specifically to a capital city - the political center of a country.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首都|しゅと}{圏|けん} (capital region, metropolitan area)
- {首都|しゅと}{高速|こうそく} (metropolitan expressway)
- {首都|しゅと}{移転|いてん} (capital relocation)
- {首都|しゅと}{機能|きのう} (capital functions)

WORLD CAPITALS:
- {東京|とうきょう} (Tokyo - Japan)
- ワシントンD.C. (Washington D.C. - USA)
- ロンドン (London - UK)
- {北京|ぺきん} (Beijing - China)
- ソウル (Seoul - South Korea)

RELATED TERMS:
- {首都|しゅと}: capital city (political center)
- {都|みやこ}: capital, metropolis (literary/traditional)
- {大都市|だいとし}: large city, major city
